stages.name: official_api_contract_check
stages.tool: Google official Gemini embeddings API and pricing documentation
checks: Used synchronous models.batchEmbedContents, not the separate asynchronous Batch API whose Free Tier is unavailable.
The endpoint returned five 768-dimensional normalized vectors in one external HTTP call.

stages.name: portable_section_aware_chunk_maker
checks: 512/100 produced four exact-substring child chunks over PDF pages 191-192.
1024/200 produced two page-sized chunks and reused approved page vectors.
Every child retained source_id, parent_chunk_id, pdf_page, hash and exact source text.

stages.name: bilingual_retrieval_and_refusal
stages.tool: Gemini embedding-2 plus deterministic source-term gate
checks: Traditional Chinese and English habitual-constipation queries ranked a term-bearing page-192 chunk first under all three profiles.
The chromosome-count query remained blocked because the approved pages contain none of its required source terms.
No Libra probe entered formal acceptance.

stages.name: independent_checker
stages.tool: validate-chunking-ab.py plus Codex sampled raw-evidence inspection
checks: Source PDF size matched the manifest and every child was an exact parent-page substring.
All vector norms, overlaps, hashes, citations, evidence gates and review statuses passed.
The selected 512/100 profile is approved only in the bounded experiment index.

stages.name: profile_selection
stages.tool: declared MRR, recall@1, evidence-margin, refusal and citation selection rule
checks: All profiles achieved mean MRR 1.0, recall@1 1.0, refusal precision 1.0 and citation completeness 1.0.
512/100 increased mean evidence margin from 0.015480 to 0.029797 and was selected.
Overlapping child results must be collapsed by parent page before final top-k presentation.

warnings: This result covers only Podophyllum PDF pages 191-192 and must be sampled on other volumes before full-book promotion.
The 1024/200 candidate was identical to the page baseline on these short pages, so this sample cannot measure its behavior on longer sections.
The main embedding index still enforces one vector per page and must be migrated before 512/100 becomes the production batch path.
Podophyllum has no approved Taiwan display-name decision yet and remains excluded from chat answers.
